verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll, HR, compliance and business-formation platform, so a library of vetted legal templates is a fair question for it. The evidence covers company formation, EIN registration, state tax registration, annual reports and registered-agent services, but never mentions NDA, agreement or policy templates. Gusto also states its compliance service is operational help that works alongside a lawyer, not in place of one.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a library of vetted standard legal templates (NDAs, agreements, policies) instead of hiring counsel for routine documents
